scenes.label: PayDece · Friday, September 25
scenes.text: The week the product turned a corner. 301 weekly actives, retention up.
scenes.voice: Friday at PayDece: the week the product turned a corner. Three hundred and one weekly actives, and retention is up.

scenes.label: Weekly active users
scenes.voice: Weekly active users: three hundred and one, fifteen percent more than last week, and the eighth week of growth in a row.

scenes.label: Activation this week
scenes.voice: Activation: of four hundred and twelve sign-ups, two hundred and forty-one got their first video. Fifty-eight percent, and one hundred seventy-four came back the next day.

scenes.label: Day-7 retention by cohort
scenes.voice: Day-seven retention: forty-six percent for this week's cohort, four points better than last week's, and the best so far.

items.text: 3 open: timezone onboarding, clip timing, heartbeat

scenes.voice: From engineering, Theo reports five green builds, three open bugs, and three things shipped: agent-to-agent comms, number sources and the install flow.

scenes.label: Bugs: opened vs. closed
scenes.voice: Bugs: seven closed this week, three still open, none opened today.

scenes.text: Demo call with a prospect today: they want their KPI sheet as a source, and a video they can forward to their board
scenes.voice: Rodrigo, from today's demo call: they want their KPI sheet as a source, and a video they can forward to their board.

scenes.label: Next
scenes.voice: Next: cohort forty starts Monday with a retention target of forty-eight, and the timezone fix ships Tuesday.
